description: Host the game's files at a public share link, https://<slug>.play.multiplayeragent.com/ (the game's own origin; the slug comes from the game's name and never changes). Send every file the game needs: an index.html at the root plus any JS/CSS/assets, paths relative to it. Text goes as utf8 content; images, audio and other binaries as base64 with encoding: "base64". The files must use THIS game's publishable key (it is how the server knows the build belongs to this game; a client wired to another game is refused). Re-run after every change: it replaces the hosted files and the link stays the same. Limits: 100 files, 5 MB in total. Give the user the url: anyone who opens it joins the same rooms. Nothing is listed publicly; only people with the link find it.

files.description: Every file of the game, including index.html.

content.description: The file's content: the text itself, or base64 when encoding is 'base64'.

path.description: Path relative to the game root, e.g. 'index.html' or 'assets/ship.png'.

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

name: publish_game
title: Host the game at a share link
